The surgery this patient needs is a laparoscopic appendectomy, and that is what we will do in the operating room.
Broaden the differential: consider ectopic pregnancy, ovarian torsion, ruptured ovarian cyst.
Also missed pain migration: Pain that starts at the umbilicus and moves to the right lower quadrant is the classic appendicitis pattern.
Also missed nausea and vomiting: Anorexia and nausea after the pain starts support appendicitis.
Also missed fever: Fever points to inflammation and, when high, to perforation.
